    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)+1
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)+1
    h,w=r1-r0,c1-c0

    out=[]

            v=grid[rr][cc]
            if v==8:
                v=grid[(rr+15)%30][cc]
            line.append(v)
        out.append(line)
    return out
",
